text: 国务院国资委财管运行局负责人裴仁佺14日在国新办举行的国务院政策例行吹风会上说，《关于加强中小企业回款难问题治理有关工作的通知》对央企发挥表率作用提出专门要求。接下来，中央企业将积极筹措资金，确保及时支付；今后更要把对中小企业现金支付作为一条“硬杠杠”坚持好，同时结合自身实际对大型企业保持合理现金支付比例，推动沿业务链条传导，并严格“票证”使用，严禁新开6个月以上“票证”；将督促央企带头遵守所在行业领域规定，率先在合同中明确四项关键要素，率先响应并践行行业及时支付倡议等。（新华社）
text_en: Pei Renquan, head of the Finance and Operation Bureau of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, said on the 14th at a regular State Council policy briefing held by the State Council Information Office that the Notice on Strengthening the Governance of the Difficulty Small and Medium-sized Enterprises Face in Getting Paid sets specific requirements for central enterprises to play an exemplary role. Next, central enterprises will actively raise funds to ensure timely payment; going forward, they must treat cash payment to small and medium-sized enterprises as a "hard benchmark" and adhere to it, while maintaining a reasonable cash payment ratio for large enterprises based on their own actual circumstances, promoting transmission along the business chain, and strictly regulating the use of "bills and certificates," with a strict prohibition on newly issuing "bills and certificates" with maturities of more than 6 months; they will urge central enterprises to take the lead in complying with the regulations of their respective industries and fields, be the first to specify four key elements in contracts, and be the first to respond to and practice industry timely payment initiatives, among other things. (Xinhua News Agency)
